remarks: Discover an extraordinary opportunity to own 174 breathtaking acres in the heart of Cattaraugus County. This remarkable property offers the perfect combination of luxury, recreation, privacy, and income potential, all just 20 minutes from the renowned ski slopes and year-round attractions of Ellicottville. The custom-built Cape Cod home features 2 bedrooms and 1-1/2 baths with exceptional craftsmanship throughout. Warm wood finishes, custom woodworking, soaring cathedral ceilings, and radiant in-floor heat create an inviting atmosphere that's both cozy and elegant. The spacious primary suite offers a private ensuite bath, while the covered front porch provides the perfect place to relax and take in spectacular long-range valley views. Outside, the possibilities are endless. Approximately 45 acres of open fields blend seamlessly into mature hardwood forests, creating an ideal setting for farming, hunting, hiking, ATV riding, horseback riding, or simply enjoying nature. A stunning natural waterfall and spring-fed mountain water enhance the beauty and uniqueness of the land. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the established trail system winding throughout the property, exceptional hunting habitat, and multiple scenic locations perfect for RVs or future cabins. The south western-facing acreage enjoys excellent sun exposure and was once part of a thriving maple syrup operation. Approximately 2,000 maple taps remain possible, with much of the tubing system still in place, offering an exciting opportunity to revive a productive maple business. Whether you're searching for a private family retreat, recreational paradise, working homestead, hunting property, or investment with income potential, this one-of-a-kind estate offers it all. This is more than a home—it's a legacy property offering unmatched beauty, privacy, and endless possibilities in one of Western New York's most desirable recreational regions. OGM's are owned and may convey with acceptable offer. Note; Includes adjoining parcel 044089-49.003-1-15 consisting of 1.3 acres.(not included in overall acreage or tax total) Square footage taken from actual measurements.
